words.enDefinition: a large tiered room where big classes meet

examples.en: Intro psychology meets in the biggest lecture hall on campus.
examples.zh: 心理学导论课在学校最大的「阶梯教室」上。

examples.en: Grab a seat early or the lecture hall fills up fast.
examples.zh: 早点占座，不然「阶梯教室」很快就坐满了。

collocations: the back of the lecture hall

words.enDefinition: the slide file a professor shows during class

examples.en: Our professor posts the PowerPoint slides online after every lecture.
examples.zh: 我们教授每次课后都会把「PPT幻灯片」传到网上。

examples.en: I add my own notes directly on the PowerPoint slides.
examples.zh: 我直接在「PPT幻灯片」上加自己的笔记。

collocations: the PowerPoint slides for today's class

words.enDefinition: record which students are present in class

examples.en: The TA takes attendance during the first five minutes of class.
examples.zh: 助教在上课前五分钟「点名」。

examples.en: Some professors take attendance at every single lecture, so don't skip.
examples.zh: 有的教授每节课都「点名记考勤」，所以别翘课。

words.enDefinition: reading each student's name aloud to check presence

examples.en: Roll call takes forever in a class of two hundred students.
examples.zh: 两百人的班做「点名」要花好长时间。

examples.en: The TA started roll call right at nine o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 助教九点整准时开始「点名」。

words.enDefinition: a short fun activity that helps strangers start talking

examples.en: Our first seminar started with a slightly awkward icebreaker game.
examples.zh: 研讨课第一节做了一个有点尴尬的「破冰活动」。

examples.en: The icebreaker helped me learn the names of three classmates.
examples.zh: 这个「破冰活动」让我记住了三位同学的名字。

words.enDefinition: the relaxed first week when professors mainly review course plans

examples.en: During syllabus week, most classes end twenty minutes earlier than scheduled.
examples.zh: 「开学轻松第一周」大多数课都会比课表提前二十分钟下课。

examples.en: Everyone makes friends during syllabus week before the real workload starts.
examples.zh: 趁着「开学轻松第一周」，大家抓紧交朋友，正课还没开始。

words.enDefinition: lift your hand to speak or answer in class

examples.en: Raise your hand if you want the professor to repeat the question.
examples.zh: 想让教授再讲一遍问题就「举手」。

examples.en: I raised my hand, but the TA called on someone else first.
examples.zh: 我「举手」了，但助教先点了别人。

words.enDefinition: an unexpected question aimed at a random unprepared student

examples.en: I got a cold call in statistics even though my hand was down.
examples.zh: 统计课上我被「随机点名提问」了，明明我没举手。

examples.en: Everyone sits up straighter when the professor is known for cold calls.
examples.zh: 这位教授以「随机点名」出名，大家坐得都端正多了。

words.enDefinition: choose one student to answer a question

examples.en: The professor called on a student sitting in the front row.
examples.zh: 教授「点了」坐在前排的一个学生回答。

examples.en: The tutor might call on a student who has not volunteered to answer.
examples.zh: 导师可能会「点一名学生回答」，即使那名学生没有举手。

collocations: call on someone in the back

words.enDefinition: scheduled times when students can visit a professor

examples.en: Office hours are listed on the first page of the syllabus.
examples.zh: 「教授答疑时间」写在教学大纲第一页。

examples.en: I stopped by office hours to ask about my essay feedback.
examples.zh: 我趁「答疑时间」去问了一下论文的反馈。

words.enDefinition: reserve a time slot to meet a professor

examples.en: You have to book office hours through the online scheduling system.
examples.zh: 你需要在预约系统上「预约答疑时间」。

examples.en: I tried to book office hours before the slots filled up for midterms.
examples.zh: 期中考试前，我趁名额还没满「预约答疑时间」。

words.enDefinition: write down key points during a lecture

examples.en: I take notes by hand because typing on a laptop distracts me.
examples.zh: 我习惯手写「记笔记」，用电脑打字容易分心。

examples.en: Take notes during the lecture, or you'll miss all the examples.
examples.zh: 上课一定要「记笔记」，不然会漏掉所有例子。

words.enDefinition: the habit of writing down important points in class

examples.en: Good note-taking makes reviewing for exams so much easier later.
examples.zh: 「做笔记」做得好，后面复习考试就轻松多了。

examples.en: My note-taking improved a lot after I learned the outline method.
examples.zh: 学会大纲法之后，我「做笔记」的水平提高了不少。

words.enDefinition: a question that checks what a statement really means

examples.en: Can I ask a clarifying question about the second step?
examples.zh: 关于第二步，我可以提个「澄清性提问」吗？

examples.en: No clarifying question is too small to ask during office hours.
examples.zh: 答疑时间问多小的「澄清性问题」都不嫌小。

collocations: a clarifying question about the instructions

words.enDefinition: an extra question built on the previous answer

examples.en: The guest speaker welcomed follow-up questions for twenty minutes after her talk.
examples.zh: 演讲嘉宾的报告结束后，花了二十分钟接受大家「追问」。

examples.en: I asked a follow-up question about the study's sample size.
examples.zh: 我就研究的样本量「追问」了一个问题。

words.enDefinition: review material from classes you failed to attend

examples.en: I spent the whole weekend catching up on missed lectures before the quiz.
examples.zh: 测验前，我整个周末都在「补落下的课」。

examples.en: Borrowing a friend's notes helps you catch up on missed lectures faster.
examples.zh: 借同学的笔记能更快「补上落下的课」。

collocations: catch up on missed lectures over the weekend

words.enDefinition: a class talk given by an invited outside expert

examples.en: Our marketing class has a guest lecture from an alum this Friday.
examples.zh: 周五市场营销课有一位校友来讲「特邀讲座」。

examples.en: Attendance is mandatory for tomorrow's guest lecture, so arrive early.
examples.zh: 明天的「特邀讲座」必须到场，记得早点去。

words.enDefinition: an outside expert invited to address a class

examples.en: The guest speaker drove three hours to talk to our seminar.
examples.zh: 「主讲嘉宾」开了三个小时车来给我们研讨课做分享。

examples.en: Our guest speaker stayed an extra twenty minutes for questions.
examples.zh: 「主讲嘉宾」多留了二十分钟回答问题。

words.enDefinition: a class visit to a museum, company, or natural site

examples.en: Our geology class has a field trip to the river canyon on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六地质课要去河谷「实地考察」。

examples.en: Sign the field trip waiver by Friday, or you can't go.
examples.zh: 周五前签好「实地考察」同意书，不然去不了。

collocations: a field trip to a museum

words.enDefinition: a scheduled hands-on practical class in a laboratory

examples.en: Every lab session starts with a ten-minute safety briefing at the door.
examples.zh: 每次「实验课」进门后都有十分钟的安全讲解。

examples.en: You must wear closed-toe shoes to every chemistry lab session.
examples.zh: 上化学「实验课」必须穿包趾鞋。

words.enDefinition: a whole-group conversation about the day's topic or reading

examples.en: The professor grades us on how much we join the class discussion.
examples.zh: 教授按我们「课堂讨论」的参与度打分。

examples.en: Today's class discussion completely changed how I see the novel.
examples.zh: 今天的「课堂讨论」完全改变了我对这本小说的看法。

words.enDefinition: a printed sheet the professor distributes in class

examples.en: Grab a handout from the pile next to the door.
examples.zh: 从门边那摞纸里拿一份「课堂讲义」。

examples.en: The handout summarizes every formula we covered on today's slides.
examples.zh: 这份「讲义」总结了今天幻灯片上的所有公式。

collocations: an extra copy of the handout

words.enDefinition: a smooth classroom board written on with erasable markers

examples.en: The professor filled the whiteboard with derivations in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 教授十分钟就在「白板」上写满了推导过程。

examples.en: Can someone take a photo of the whiteboard before it gets erased?
examples.zh: 「白板」被擦掉之前，谁能拍张照吗？

words.enDefinition: the seats farthest from the front of the room

examples.en: From the back row, you can barely read the slides.
examples.zh: 坐「后排」几乎看不清幻灯片上的字。

examples.en: I moved from the back row to the front to focus better.
examples.zh: 为了更专心，我把座位从「后排」换到了前面。

words.enDefinition: attend a class you are not enrolled in

examples.en: First-years often sit in on a lecture before choosing their major.
examples.zh: 很多新生在定专业前会去「旁听课」。

examples.en: Can I sit in on your lecture tomorrow? I'm considering the class.
examples.zh: 我明天能去「旁听」你的课吗？我在考虑选这门课。

collocations: sit in on the first lecture

words.enDefinition: a graduate student who leads sections and grades work

examples.en: Email the teaching assistant first; the professor gets too many messages.
examples.zh: 有事先给「助教」发邮件，教授的邮件太多了。

examples.en: Our teaching assistant runs a review session every Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 我们的「助教」每周四晚上组织复习。

words.enDefinition: a teaching-focused faculty member for a course

examples.en: Our statistics lecturer uses real news stories to explain every concept.
examples.zh: 我们的统计「讲师」总用真实新闻来讲解概念。

examples.en: The visiting lecturer stayed twenty minutes late to answer questions.
examples.zh: 那位来访「讲师」晚走了二十分钟答疑。

words.enDefinition: another student taking the same course as you

examples.en: My classmate lent me her notes when I was out sick.
examples.zh: 我生病没来时，「同班同学」把笔记借给了我。

examples.en: I always sit next to a classmate from my dorm.
examples.zh: 我总是和宿舍的「同学」坐在一起。

words.enDefinition: the student who shares your lab workspace

examples.en: My lab partner and I split the measurements to save time.
examples.zh: 我和「实验搭档」分工测量来节省时间。

examples.en: Ask the TA to switch you to a new lab partner.
examples.zh: 可以找助教把你换到新的「实验搭档」那组。

words.enDefinition: the seats closest to the professor

examples.en: The front row is always empty in the eight a.m. class.
examples.zh: 早八的课「前排」永远没人坐。

examples.en: Sitting in the front row makes it easier to ask questions.
examples.zh: 坐「前排」更容易提问。

words.enDefinition: fixed seats chosen for each student in advance

examples.en: The professor uses assigned seating to learn our names faster.
examples.zh: 教授用「指定座位」来更快记住我们的名字。

examples.en: There's no assigned seating, so come early for a good spot.
examples.zh: 这门课没有「指定座位」，想坐好位置就来早点。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing where every student sits

examples.en: The TA updated the seating chart after three students dropped the class.
examples.zh: 三名学生退课后，助教更新了「座位表」。

examples.en: Check the seating chart taped next to the door on day one.
examples.zh: 第一天先看看贴在门边的「座位表」。

collocations: a seating chart by the door

words.enDefinition: keep a chair free for someone arriving later

examples.en: Can you save a seat for me? I'm coming from the library.
examples.zh: 帮我「占个座」好吗？我从图书馆过来。

examples.en: Save a seat near the outlet so I can charge my laptop.
examples.zh: 帮我「占」个靠插座的座位，我要给笔记本充电。

collocations: save a seat near the front

words.enDefinition: look for an empty chair when class starts

examples.en: Come ten minutes early, or you'll struggle to find a seat.
examples.zh: 早到十分钟，不然你很难「找到座位」。

examples.en: Finding a seat in a packed lecture hall takes real skill.
examples.zh: 在挤满人的大教室里「找座位」真是个技术活。

words.enDefinition: sit down in an available chair

examples.en: Please take a seat anywhere in the first three rows.
examples.zh: 请随意「就座」，前三排都可以。

examples.en: Students were still taking their seats when the professor began.
examples.zh: 教授开讲时，大家还在「找位子坐」。

words.enDefinition: exchange chairs with another student

examples.en: Can we switch seats? Your view of the projector is better.
examples.zh: 我们「换下座位」好吗？你那边看投影更清楚。

examples.en: The TA asked the two chatting students to switch seats immediately.
examples.zh: 助教让两个说话的学生马上「换了座位」。

words.enDefinition: a room you enter by mistake

examples.en: I knew it was the wrong classroom when nobody recognized the slides.
examples.zh: 没人认识这些幻灯片，我才意识到「走错了教室」。

examples.en: Syllabus week is full of students wandering into the wrong classroom.
examples.zh: 开学第一周，到处都是「走错教室」的学生。

words.enDefinition: with all your classmates watching and listening

examples.en: Speaking in front of the class gets easier every single week.
examples.zh: 「当着全班」发言，每周都会容易一点。

examples.en: She demonstrated the whole experiment in front of the class without notes.
examples.zh: 她不用讲稿就「当着全班的面」演示了整个实验。

collocations: speak in front of the class
present in front of the class
nervous in front of the class

words.enDefinition: a dark classroom board written on with chalk

examples.en: Our math professor still prefers an old chalkboard to PowerPoint slides.
examples.zh: 我们的数学教授宁愿用老式「黑板」，也不用幻灯片。

examples.en: Copy the diagram from the chalkboard before someone erases it.
examples.zh: 趁没被擦掉，快把「黑板」上的图抄下来。

words.enDefinition: a machine that displays slides on a large screen

examples.en: The projector in this room always blurs the small text.
examples.zh: 这间教室的「投影仪」总是把小字弄糊。

examples.en: The TA couldn't get the projector to connect to her laptop.
examples.zh: 助教怎么都没法让「投影仪」连上她的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a handheld device that casts a moving red dot on slides

examples.en: The professor waved the laser pointer all over the slide.
examples.zh: 教授拿着「激光笔」在幻灯片上晃来晃去。

examples.en: Hold the laser pointer steady when you point at the graph.
examples.zh: 指图表时请把「激光笔」拿稳。

words.enDefinition: a small standing desk for the speaker at the front

examples.en: The professor stepped away from the podium to draw on the board.
examples.zh: 教授离开「讲台」去黑板上画图。

examples.en: There's a laptop and a microphone on the lecture hall podium.
examples.zh: 大教室的「讲台」上放着笔记本电脑和麦克风。

words.enDefinition: a handheld device for answering in-class polls

examples.en: Bring your clicker to every statistics lecture for the in-class polls.
examples.zh: 每节统计课都带上「课堂答题器」，课上要用它答题。

examples.en: I forgot my clicker, so I answered the polls with the class app.
examples.zh: 我忘带「答题器」了，就用课堂App做了答题。

words.enDefinition: the complete set of slides for one lecture

examples.en: The whole slide deck for chapter five is already online.
examples.zh: 第五章的整套「幻灯片课件」已经传到网上了。

examples.en: She reused last year's slide deck without updating the dates.
examples.zh: 她直接沿用了去年的「课件」，连日期都没改。

words.enDefinition: a printed sheet of practice problems or tasks

examples.en: You should finish the worksheet before the end of today's class.
examples.zh: 请在今天下课前完成这份「课堂练习单」。

examples.en: The TA handed out a practice worksheet on quadratic equations.
examples.zh: 助教发了一份二次方程的「练习单」。

words.enDefinition: a circulating list where students sign to confirm presence

examples.en: Pass the attendance sheet to the end of your row.
examples.zh: 把「签到表」传到你那排最右边。

examples.en: Sign the attendance sheet, or you'll be marked absent for today.
examples.zh: 一定要在「签到表」上签名，不然今天会记旷课。

words.enDefinition: the official history of who attended which classes

examples.en: Your attendance record affects your participation grade in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课的「出勤记录」会影响平时成绩。

examples.en: Ask the department to correct any error in your attendance record.
examples.zh: 「出勤记录」有误的话，可以找系里更正。

words.enDefinition: a posted list where people claim time slots

examples.en: There's a sign-up sheet on her door for office hours slots.
examples.zh: 她办公室门上有一张答疑时段的「登记表」。

examples.en: Write your name on the sign-up sheet for presentation slots.
examples.zh: 想选报告时段，就把名字写在「登记表」上。

collocations: a sign-up sheet on the door
add your name to the sign-up sheet

words.enDefinition: the official list of students enrolled in a course

examples.en: The professor reads names from the class roster on day one.
examples.zh: 第一天教授照着「班级名册」念名字。

examples.en: You won't appear on the class roster until registration clears.
examples.zh: 注册流程走完之前，「班级名册」上不会有你。

words.enDefinition: the notes a student writes during class

examples.en: I review my lecture notes within a day of each class.
examples.zh: 每次课后一天内，我会复习「课堂笔记」。

examples.en: She shares her lecture notes with the whole class group chat.
examples.zh: 她把「课堂笔记」分享到了班级群聊里。

words.enDefinition: simple writing tools instead of a laptop

examples.en: Leave the laptop at home; pen and paper works fine.
examples.zh: 别带电脑了，用「笔和纸」就够了。

examples.en: I remember more when I take notes with pen and paper.
examples.zh: 用「纸笔」记笔记，我记住的东西更多。

collocations: pen and paper instead of a laptop

words.enDefinition: one short listed item on a slide or handout

examples.en: Keep each bullet point on the slide to five words or fewer.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上每条「要点」最好不超过五个词。

examples.en: He just read every bullet point straight off the slide.
examples.zh: 他就是把幻灯片上的「要点」一条条念了出来。

words.enDefinition: protective plastic glasses worn in science labs

examples.en: You can't enter the lab without safety goggles and closed shoes.
examples.zh: 不戴「护目镜」和包趾鞋不能进实验室。

examples.en: You can buy safety goggles at the campus bookstore for eight dollars.
examples.zh: 「护目镜」在校内书店八美元就能买到。

words.enDefinition: the long worktable where experiments are done

examples.en: Our lab bench has a sink and its own set of drawers.
examples.zh: 我们这组「实验台」带水槽和抽屉。

examples.en: Clean your lab bench thoroughly before you leave the lab.
examples.zh: 离开实验室前要把「实验台」清理干净。

words.enDefinition: the booklet of procedures for a lab course

examples.en: Read the lab manual before every session, or you'll fall behind.
examples.zh: 每次实验前都要读「实验手册」，不然会跟不上。

examples.en: The lab manual costs about twenty dollars at the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 这本「实验手册」在校内书店卖二十美元左右。

words.enDefinition: a white protective coat worn in laboratories

examples.en: Borrow a lab coat from the rack by the door.
examples.zh: 从门边的架子上借一件「实验服」。

examples.en: Chemistry students must wear a lab coat over their regular clothes.
examples.zh: 化学课学生必须在衣服外面再穿「实验服」。

words.enDefinition: a device that magnifies tiny samples for study

examples.en: Each pair of students shares one microscope at the bench.
examples.zh: 每两名学生共用一台「显微镜」。

examples.en: Focus the microscope slowly, or you'll lose the cell again.
examples.zh: 「显微镜」要慢慢调焦，不然又找不到细胞了。

words.enDefinition: A short written plan of the main topics and their order in a lecture.

examples.en: The lecturer posted a lecture outline so students could organise their notes before class.
examples.zh: 老师发布了「讲课提纲」，方便学生在课前把笔记安排好。

examples.en: I used the lecture outline to check which topics were covered while I was away.
examples.zh: 我查看「讲课提纲」，了解请假期间讲了哪些主题。

words.enDefinition: an extra class held to prepare for an exam

examples.en: The TA is holding a review session the night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前一晚，助教会安排「复习课」。

examples.en: The review session covered everything from the first four weeks.
examples.zh: 这次「复习课」把前四周的内容都过了一遍。

collocations: a review session before the exam

words.enDefinition: a set of related talks spread over several weeks

examples.en: The economics department runs a free lecture series every fall.
examples.zh: 经济系每年秋天办免费的「系列讲座」。

examples.en: I attended the entire lecture series on climate policy this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天那套气候政策的「系列讲座」我全听了。

words.enDefinition: a talk open to the whole campus and community

examples.en: The Nobel winner is giving a public lecture on Thursday night.
examples.zh: 那位诺奖得主周四晚上有一场「公开讲座」。

examples.en: Public lectures are a free way to hear top researchers.
examples.zh: 「公开讲座」是免费听顶尖学者报告的好机会。

words.enDefinition: a short unannounced test given at the start of class

examples.en: The professor started today's class with a five-minute pop quiz.
examples.zh: 教授今天上课先来了个五分钟的「随堂测验」。

examples.en: A pop quiz counts toward your final grade in this course.
examples.zh: 「随堂测验」会计入这门课的总评。

collocations: a pop quiz at the start

words.enDefinition: an extra meeting rescheduled after a cancelled class

examples.en: The Monday makeup class is in the same room at five.
examples.zh: 周一的「补课」还在原教室，五点开始。

examples.en: Check your email for this week's makeup class time and room.
examples.zh: 本周「补课」的时间和教室请查收邮件。

words.enDefinition: Cancellation of an individual scheduled class meeting.

examples.en: The class cancellation affected Friday's meeting, and we still had to attend the Monday lecture.
examples.zh: 这次「单次停课」只影响周五的课，周一的讲座还是要去。

examples.en: We received a class cancellation notice before most students had left for campus.
examples.zh: 大多数学生还没出门去学校，我们就收到了「单次停课」通知。

words.enDefinition: a course mixing in-person and online sessions

examples.en: My Tuesday seminar is a hybrid class; we meet in person twice a month.
examples.zh: 我周二的研讨课是「混合式课程」，每月只线下见两次。

examples.en: Hybrid classes let you watch recorded lectures from your dorm.
examples.zh: 「混合式课程」可以让你在宿舍看录播。

words.enDefinition: a class session delivered live or recorded on the internet

examples.en: The professor posts each online lecture by seven the evening before.
examples.zh: 教授在前一晚七点前上传「网课」视频。

examples.en: I watch the online lecture at double speed to save time.
examples.zh: 我用两倍速看「网课」来省时间。

words.enDefinition: videos watched before class, practice done in person

examples.en: In a flipped classroom, you watch the videos before class starts.
examples.zh: 「翻转课堂」要求上课前先看完视频。

examples.en: The flipped classroom format frees class time for problem solving.
examples.zh: 「翻转课堂」把课上时间留给做题。

words.enDefinition: a small group space for timed discussions during class

examples.en: We discussed the case study in breakout rooms for fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 我们分组在「讨论室」里讨论了十五分钟的案例。

examples.en: Each breakout room had to nominate one person to report back.
examples.zh: 每个「分组讨论室」要推选一人汇报。

collocations: report back from your breakout room

words.enDefinition: the number of students enrolled in a course

examples.en: The class size is capped at thirty for the writing seminar.
examples.zh: 写作研讨课的「班级人数」上限三十人。

examples.en: A small class size means every student gets more speaking time.
examples.zh: 「班级人数」少，每个学生的开口机会就多。

words.enDefinition: the first meeting of a course in a term

examples.en: On the first day of class, most professors let everyone out early.
examples.zh: 「开学第一天」，大多数教授都会早下课。

examples.en: I bought the textbook before the first day of class and barely used it.
examples.zh: 我在「开学第一天」前就买了教材，结果几乎没用上。

collocations: on the first day of class
before the first day of class

words.enDefinition: the final scheduled meeting of a course

examples.en: On the last day of class, the professor reviews the whole course.
examples.zh: 「最后一节课」上，教授会把整门课串讲一遍。

examples.en: The last day of class is Friday, and the final exam is Monday.
examples.zh: 周五是「最后一节课」，周一就期末考了。

collocations: on the last day of class
before the last day of class
the last day of class review

words.enDefinition: time set aside for audience questions after a talk

examples.en: The Q&A session after the guest lecture ran twenty minutes long.
examples.zh: 特邀讲座后的「问答环节」拖了二十分钟。

examples.en: Nobody asked anything during the Q&A session, so it ended early.
examples.zh: 「问答环节」没人提问，就提前结束了。

words.enDefinition: a campus room full of computers for student use

examples.en: The computer lab on the third floor stays open until midnight.
examples.zh: 三楼的「机房」开放到半夜。

examples.en: Print your lab report in the computer lab before class.
examples.zh: 上课前到「机房」把实验报告打印出来。

words.enDefinition: listen and watch carefully instead of drifting off

examples.en: Pay special attention whenever the professor repeats a point twice.
examples.zh: 教授把一个点讲两遍时，要格外「集中注意力」。

examples.en: It's hard to pay attention in a three-hour afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午连上三小时的课，很难「专心」。

words.enDefinition: join discussions and activities during a lesson

examples.en: Participating in class counts for twenty percent of our grade.
examples.zh: 「课堂发言」占我们成绩的百分之二十。

examples.en: Many international students feel nervous when they participate in class.
examples.zh: 很多留学生一想到要「课堂发言」就紧张。

words.enDefinition: marks awarded for speaking and joining class activities

examples.en: Class participation makes up twenty percent of our final grade.
examples.zh: 「课堂参与」占总评的百分之二十。

examples.en: She earned full marks for class participation by commenting every week.
examples.zh: 她每周都发言，「课堂参与分」拿了满分。

words.enDefinition: read text out loud so others can hear

examples.en: The professor asked a volunteer to read the quote aloud.
examples.zh: 教授请一位自愿的同学「朗读」那段引文。

examples.en: Reading aloud in a second language feels scary at first.
examples.zh: 用外语「朗读」一开始会让人害怕。

words.enDefinition: keep pace with the professor's explanation

examples.en: Follow along with the handout while I explain the proof.
examples.zh: 我讲证明时，请大家对照讲义「跟上讲解」。

examples.en: I lost my place in the notes and couldn't follow along.
examples.zh: 我笔记记乱了位，后来就「跟不上」了。

words.enDefinition: a quick vote made by raising hands

examples.en: By a show of hands, who has finished the reading?
examples.zh: 「举个手」看看，读完阅读材料的有多少人？

examples.en: The professor took a show of hands before choosing the debate topic.
examples.zh: 教授先「举手表决」来定辩论题目。

words.enDefinition: a guess supported by knowledge and reasoning

examples.en: I don't know the answer, but I'll make an educated guess.
examples.zh: 我不知道答案，但可以做个「有依据的推测」。

examples.en: Even an educated guess is better than sitting there in silence.
examples.zh: 哪怕是「合理推测」，也比全程沉默强。

words.enDefinition: a guess made with no real basis

examples.en: On the multiple-choice section, even a wild guess sometimes earns credit.
examples.zh: 选择题部分哪怕「瞎猜」有时也能得分。

examples.en: Question four was a total wild guess; I had no idea.
examples.zh: 第四题纯属「瞎猜」，我完全没头绪。

collocations: a wild guess on the quiz

words.enDefinition: suddenly fail to remember or think of an answer

examples.en: I drew a blank the moment the professor called my name.
examples.zh: 教授点到我名字的那一刻，我「大脑一片空白」。

examples.en: Even after studying all night, I drew a blank on the first question.
examples.zh: 复习了一整晚，第一题我还是「什么都想不起来」。

collocations: draw a blank on the test

words.enDefinition: forget what you were about to say next

examples.en: Excuse me, I lost my train of thought — where was I?
examples.zh: 不好意思，我「思路断了」——刚说到哪儿了？

examples.en: Someone's phone rang, and I lost my train of thought mid-sentence.
examples.zh: 有人手机响了，我讲到一半「思路就断了」。

collocations: lose my train of thought mid-sentence

words.enDefinition: offer to answer without being called on

examples.en: Nobody volunteered an answer, so the professor waited in silence.
examples.zh: 没人「主动回答」，教授就安静地等着。

examples.en: Volunteering an answer at least once a week boosts your participation score.
examples.zh: 每周至少「主动答一次题」，能提高你的课堂参与分。

words.enDefinition: say something briefly while someone else is talking

examples.en: She interjected politely to add a counterexample from her own research.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地「插话」，补充了一个自己研究里的反例。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to interject with a short question in seminars.
examples.zh: 研讨课上别怕用简短的问题「插话」。

words.enDefinition: check and share what each person wrote or understood

examples.en: Want to compare notes after class? I missed the second half.
examples.zh: 课后「对一下笔记」好吗？我后半节没听。

examples.en: We compared notes and discovered we'd each caught different examples.
examples.zh: 我们一「对笔记」，发现各自记到的例子不一样。

words.enDefinition: make an audio or video copy of a class session

examples.en: Ask permission before you record a lecture on your phone.
examples.zh: 用手机「录课」前要先征得教授同意。

examples.en: I record the lecture so I can replay the fast parts later.
examples.zh: 我会「录下讲课内容」，回头把讲得快的地方再放一遍。

collocations: record the lecture on your phone

words.enDefinition: deliberately not attend a scheduled class

examples.en: I skipped class twice this month and missed two quizzes.
examples.zh: 这个月我「翘」了两次课，错过了两次测验。

examples.en: Skipping one lecture is fine, but skipping class every week catches up with you.
examples.zh: 偶尔「翘课」一次没事，但每周都翘迟早要还的。

words.enDefinition: enter quietly and unnoticed after class has started

examples.en: I tried to sneak in through the back door after arriving ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 我迟到了十分钟，想从后门「悄悄溜进」教室。

examples.en: Don't sneak in during a pop quiz; just email the professor instead.
examples.zh: 随堂测验的时候就别「溜进来」了，直接给教授发邮件吧。

words.enDefinition: arriving after the class has already begun

examples.en: I was late to class because the campus bus never came.
examples.zh: 校车一直不来，我「上课迟到」了。

examples.en: Being late to class twice counts as one absence in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课「迟到」两次算一次缺勤。

words.enDefinition: remain in the room once the lesson ends

examples.en: Stay after class if you want help with the assignment.
examples.zh: 想让老师帮忙看作业就「课后留下来」。

examples.en: The professor asked me to stay after class to discuss my essay.
examples.zh: 教授让我「课后留下」，谈谈我的论文。

collocations: stay after class for a minute
stay after class to ask questions

words.enDefinition: go before the class officially ends

examples.en: May I leave class early? I have a visa appointment at three.
examples.zh: 我可以「早退」吗？三点有个签证预约。

examples.en: The professor let us leave class early before the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末前，教授让我们「提前下课」了。

words.enDefinition: finish the lesson and be free to go

examples.en: What time do we get out of class today, three or four?
examples.zh: 今天我们几点「下课」，三点还是四点？

examples.en: I get out of class at two, so a Tuesday lunch works.
examples.zh: 我周二两点「下课」，中午一起吃饭没问题。

collocations: get out of class at two

words.enDefinition: continue past the planned finishing time

examples.en: The lecture ran over by ten minutes because of all the questions.
examples.zh: 因为提问太多，这节课「拖堂」了十分钟。

examples.en: Professors who always run over make back-to-back schedules really painful.
examples.zh: 老师总「拖堂」的话，连堂的课表就很难受了。

words.enDefinition: take turns speaking in order around the classroom

examples.en: We went around the room sharing one question each about the reading.
examples.zh: 我们「轮流发言」，每人提一个关于阅读材料的问题。

examples.en: Going around the room takes forever in a class of thirty.
examples.zh: 三十人的班「轮流发言」要好长时间。

collocations: go around the room with introductions

words.enDefinition: turn off your phone's sound before class begins

examples.en: Please silence your phone before we start the documentary screening.
examples.zh: 纪录片放映前，请把「手机调静音」。

examples.en: Remember to silence your phone; my ringtone went off once and it was mortifying.
examples.zh: 记得把「手机调成静音」，我有一次铃声响了，尴尬死了。

words.enDefinition: draw aimless pictures in your notes when bored

examples.en: I doodle in the margins when the lecture gets slow.
examples.zh: 讲得慢的时候，我就在页边「涂鸦」。

examples.en: My notes are half doodles by the end of Friday afternoon class.
examples.zh: 周五下午的课上到结束，笔记一半都是「涂鸦」。

words.enDefinition: think about something unrelated while you should be listening

examples.en: I totally daydreamed through the second half of the statistics lecture.
examples.zh: 统计课后半节我全程「走神」。

examples.en: Sit closer to the front if you tend to daydream.
examples.zh: 爱「走神」的话，就坐得离讲台近一点。

words.enDefinition: write notes or diagrams where everyone can see them

examples.en: Who wants to come up and write their answer on the board?
examples.zh: 谁愿意上来把答案「写在黑板上」？

examples.en: The professor wrote the key formula on the board three times.
examples.zh: 教授把关键公式在「黑板」上写了三遍。

collocations: write your answer on the board
write the formula on the board
come up and write on the board

words.enDefinition: a personal system of quick symbols for note-taking

examples.en: I've developed my own shorthand for terms that repeat every lecture.
examples.zh: 我自创了一套「速记」符号，用来记每节课反复出现的术语。

examples.en: My shorthand made sense to me, but nobody else could read it.
examples.zh: 我的「速记」只有自己看得懂，别人完全认不出。

words.enDefinition: write something quickly and untidily

examples.en: I scribbled down the due dates before the slide changed.
examples.zh: 幻灯片切换之前，我「匆匆记下」了截止日期。

examples.en: She scribbled down the professor's email address in the margin.
examples.zh: 她把教授的邮箱「匆匆记」在了页边。

words.enDefinition: write out exactly what is shown or said

examples.en: Copy down the practice problem before the TA erases the board.
examples.zh: 趁助教还没擦黑板，把练习题「抄下来」。

examples.en: We copied down the citation format from the last slide.
examples.zh: 我们把最后一张幻灯片上的引用格式「抄写」了下来。

words.enDefinition: turn handwritten notes into a typed document

examples.en: I type up my messy handwritten notes every Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 每周日下午，我把潦草的手写笔记「整理成电子版」。

examples.en: She typed up the lecture notes and shared the file with everyone.
examples.zh: 她把课堂笔记「整理成电子版」，发给了全班。

collocations: type up everything before the exam

words.enDefinition: short remarks written in the margins of a page

examples.en: My margin notes turned out more useful than my full sentences.
examples.zh: 结果我的「页边笔记」比整句笔记还有用。

examples.en: Compare your margin notes with the reading questions before the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课前，把自己的「页边笔记」和阅读题对照一下。

words.enDefinition: a missed class that the professor has approved

examples.en: Email the professor before the deadline to request an excused absence.
examples.zh: 想申请「获准的缺勤」，要在截止时间前给教授发邮件。

examples.en: Two excused absences are allowed per term in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课每学期允许两次「获批的缺勤」。

words.enDefinition: a missed class with no approved reason

examples.en: Every unexcused absence lowers your participation grade by two points.
examples.zh: 每次「无故缺勤」会扣两分课堂参与分。

examples.en: Three unexcused absences can get you dropped from the course.
examples.zh: 「无故缺勤」三次可能会被这门课除名。

collocations: an unexcused absence counts against you

words.enDefinition: the course rules about missing or attending class

examples.en: The attendance policy allows two free misses before the penalties start.
examples.zh: 「考勤规定」允许自由缺勤两次，之后才开始扣分。

examples.en: Check the attendance policy in the syllabus before you book flights.
examples.zh: 订机票之前，先看看大纲里的「考勤规定」。

collocations: the attendance policy in the syllabus

words.enDefinition: being present at every single class meeting

examples.en: Perfect attendance earned me five bonus points at the end of term.
examples.zh: 这学期的「全勤」让我拿到了五分加分。

examples.en: I lost perfect attendance by sleeping through one morning lecture.
examples.zh: 一节早课睡过头，我的「全勤」就没了。

words.enDefinition: fail to attend a scheduled lecture

examples.en: If you miss a lecture, the recording usually goes online that night.
examples.zh: 就算「错过一节课」，录播一般当晚就会上线。

examples.en: I missed two lectures with the flu and fell behind fast.
examples.zh: 流感让我「缺了两节课」，进度一下子跟不上了。

collocations: miss a lecture because of illness

words.enDefinition: tasks completed together by a small team in class

examples.en: Half of today's session is group work on the case study.
examples.zh: 今天一半的课时是案例「小组合作」。

examples.en: I like group work, but someone always refuses to contribute.
examples.zh: 我喜欢「小组合作」，但总有人不出力。

words.enDefinition: an activity done with the person beside you

examples.en: Do the pair work with the student sitting next to you.
examples.zh: 和旁边的同学做「结对练习」。

examples.en: Pair work is a low-pressure way to practice speaking in class.
examples.zh: 「两人结对练习」是压力较小的课堂口语练习方式。

words.enDefinition: a short task completed during the lesson

examples.en: Today's class activity is a ten-minute debate with your partner.
examples.zh: 今天的「课堂活动」是和搭档进行十分钟辩论。

examples.en: Check the schedule so you're prepared for each class activity.
examples.zh: 看好课表，每次「课堂活动」前做好准备。

words.enDefinition: a small group that meets regularly to study

examples.en: Our study group meets in the library every Wednesday night.
examples.zh: 我们「学习小组」每周三晚上在图书馆碰头。

examples.en: Join a study group before the midterm; it keeps you accountable.
examples.zh: 期中前加入一个「学习小组」，能互相督促。

words.enDefinition: a quick poll the professor runs in class

examples.en: The professor ran a quick class survey about the reading pace.
examples.zh: 教授就阅读进度做了一次快速「课堂调查」。

examples.en: Fill out the class survey by Friday so she can adjust the schedule.
examples.zh: 周五前填好「课堂调查」，方便她调整进度。

words.enDefinition: a sample sentence showing how a word is used

examples.en: Can you give us an example sentence using tonight's vocabulary?
examples.zh: 能用今晚的词汇给我们「造个例句」吗？

examples.en: Write one original example sentence for each new word tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚每个新词都要写一个原创「例句」。

words.enDefinition: a sound like um that fills a pause while speaking

examples.en: Try to cut filler words like 'um' from your presentation.
examples.zh: 做报告时尽量少用“嗯”这类「口头语」。

examples.en: Everyone uses filler words when speaking in a second language.
examples.zh: 用外语发言时，谁都免不了带点「口头语」。

words.enDefinition: a private meeting between a professor and one student

examples.en: Book a one-on-one meeting with the professor about your paper topic.
examples.zh: 关于论文选题，跟教授约个「一对一交流」吧。

examples.en: The TA offers one-on-one meetings for students nervous about asking in public.
examples.zh: 助教为不好意思当众提问的学生提供「一对一辅导」。

words.enDefinition: problems with computers, sound, or connections during class

examples.en: The lecture started fifteen minutes late because of technical difficulties.
examples.zh: 因为「技术故障」，这节课晚了十五分钟才开始。

examples.en: If you have technical difficulties during the online lecture, email the TA.
examples.zh: 上网课遇到「技术问题」，就给助教发邮件。

words.enDefinition: a course held in the evening

examples.en: My night class runs from six to nine on Tuesdays.
examples.zh: 我周二晚上六点到九点有「晚课」。

examples.en: Pack a dinner if you have a three-hour night class.
examples.zh: 上三小时的「晚课」，记得带好晚饭。

words.enDefinition: a course held early in the day

examples.en: I register for morning classes because I focus best before noon.
examples.zh: 我专挑「早课」注册，因为中午前我效率最高。

examples.en: Nothing good ever happens in an eight a.m. morning class.
examples.zh: 早八的「早课」真没什么好事发生。

words.enDefinition: the books and articles a course assigns

examples.en: The reading list has twelve books, but only three are required.
examples.zh: 「阅读书单」上有十二本书，其中只有三本必读。

examples.en: She posted the reading list a week before classes started.
examples.zh: 开课前一周，她就发布了「书单」。

words.enDefinition: take the seat beside a particular person

examples.en: Mind if I sit next to you? Every other seat is taken.
examples.zh: 我能「坐你旁边」吗？其他位置都有人了。

examples.en: I always sit next to the classmate with the neatest notes.
examples.zh: 我总挑笔记记得最工整的同学，「坐在」他旁边。

collocations: may I sit next to you

words.enDefinition: pause briefly to organize what you want to say

examples.en: Give me a second to collect my thoughts before I answer.
examples.zh: 容我想几秒，「整理一下思路」再回答。

examples.en: He paused to collect his thoughts, then gave a clear answer.
examples.zh: 他停下来「理了理思路」，然后给出了清晰的回答。

collocations: a moment to collect my thoughts

words.enDefinition: the single most important point to remember

examples.en: The key takeaway from today's lecture is on the final slide.
examples.zh: 今天这节课的「核心要点」就在最后一张幻灯片上。

examples.en: Write one key takeaway at the top of your notes.
examples.zh: 在笔记最上面写下今天的一条「核心要点」。

words.enDefinition: a short easy task that opens the lesson

examples.en: Every seminar starts with a five-minute warm-up activity in pairs.
examples.zh: 每次研讨课都以两人五分钟的「热身活动」开始。

examples.en: Today's warm-up activity reviewed all the vocabulary from last week.
examples.zh: 今天的「热身活动」把上周的词汇都过了一遍。
